root_cause: The Company Brain page introduced a new translatable literal that was not guaranteed in the static English cache and used a custom header that conflicted with the canonical shell/i18n runtime. The SEO readback also found only one inbound link and prohibited wording.
fix: Use the canonical shell instead of a custom header, complete the static translation cache for the category term and recovery copy, remove the prohibited wording, and add two contextual inbound links from existing authority pages.
prevention: Every new public route must use canonical shell ownership
Every new visible literal must be present in the static English cache before production
New category pillars require at least three contextual inbound links before live promotion
